crossRefs.note: Then Jonathan said, “My father has troubled the land. Please look how my eyes have brightened, because I tasted a…
They gave him a piece of a cake of figs, and two clusters of raisins. When he had eaten, his spirit came again to him…
Like a muddied spring and a polluted well, so is a righteous man who gives way before the wicked.

people.name: Jonathan
people.line: Eldest son of King Saul and friend of David

translations.web: But Jonathan didn’t hear when his father commanded the people with the oath. Therefore he put out the end of the rod that was in his hand, and dipped it in the honeycomb, and put his hand to his mouth; and his eyes brightened.
translations.bsb: Jonathan, however, had not heard that his father had bound the people with the oath. So he reached out the end of the staff in his hand, dipped it into the honeycomb, and put his hand to his mouth, and his eyes brightened.
translations.kjv: But Jonathan heard not when his father charged ➔ the people with the oath: wherefore he put forth the end of the rod that was in his hand, and dipped it in an honeycomb, and put his hand to his mouth; and his eyes were enlightened.
translations.asv: But Jonathan heard not when his father charged the people with the oath: wherefore he put forth the end of the rod that was in his hand, and dipped it in the honeycomb, and put his hand to his mouth; and his eyes were enlightened.
